text:
olivia: Heads-up — merged attention-kernel fusion into canary branch. Microbenchmarks look promising: p99 down by ~22% on Llama2-13B 2048 tokens, cost per token ~12% lower on our test fleet.

matt: whoa nice. can you paste the numbers?

olivia: short run summary:
- baseline p99 = 430ms
- fused-kernel p99 = 337ms
- median token throughput +18%
- perf win bigger for shorter sequences (<=512) due to fewer kernel launches

priya: do we have regression tests for output parity? any numeric diffs?

olivia: ran parity harness across 50 eval prompts (deterministic seeds)
- 0 functional regressions
- tiny fp differences, below our drift threshold

benchmark-bot: quick bench report available: https://console.redwood/bench/attn-fusion :chart_with_upwards_trend:

matt: plan to rollout canary to prod? any infra changes (drivers, CUDA)?

olivia: no driver bump needed. the fusion is in our runtime optimizer using existing kernels. rollout plan:
1) canary 5% (~2 instances) for 4h
2) expand to 25% for 6h with latency SLO checks
3) 100% if no alerts

deploy-bot: deploy started for canary (canary-id: af-2027), timestamp 1771203600

zach: nice! can we capture cost delta in the Console? want to call this out in the weekly TL;DR if stable :party:

priya: please add a smoke eval for reranking tests — sometimes beam search surfaces edgecases.

olivia: added rerank smoke, also pinned rollout with auto-rollback if p99 increases >5% or if any errors spike.

matt: anything we need from SRE/Oncall? throttling changes?

olivia: SRE should watch the model-pool autoscaler, fusion increases throughput so we might hit CPU on control plane. pinging @eng-sre

eng-sre (simon): noted, we will monitor autoscaler and will be ready to throttle if needed.

priya: timeline for merging to main?

olivia: if canary passes, merge to main tonight and trigger full rollout tomorrow morning in EU region first.

zach: awesome work team :rocket:—add a short blurb for the product channel after EU is green.

matt: logs for the bench run:
```
./bench --model llama2-13b --seq 2048 --warm 200 --steps 1000 --profile
# results: p99=337ms, median=48ms, tokens/s=1250
```

olivia: tagging metrics dashboard again: https://console.redwood/models/llama2-13b/bench/attn-fusion

benchmark-bot: canary finished, no alerts. final canary stats: p99 -19% vs baseline, cost -10% (estimated). timestamp 1771205400

olivia: thanks all. will follow up with a short postmortem-style note with graphs once we run multi-model sweeps.

matt: :thumbsup:
